notes.title: Demo Update 0.4.0
notes.content: [p]The demo has been updated to version 0.4.0.[/p][list][*][p]Increased play area outside of the dungeon.[/p][/*][*][p]New challenges and half hearts to collect.[/p][/*][*][p]More story content.[/p][/*][*][p]Bugfixes and general improvements.[/p][/*][*][p]Steam Cloud Enabled.[/p][/*][/list][p]If you tried the demo before and enjoyed it be sure to check out this version. It has a lot of new stuff.[/p]

notes.title: Demo Update 0.3.0
notes.content: [p]The demo has been updated to version 0.3.0.[/p][list][*][p]Can now sprint by holding down roll.[/p][/*][*][p]Remix several rooms.[/p][/*][*][p]Add pushback when enemies are hit.[/p][/*][*][p]Remove thrust attack. Rolling canceled into an attack is always better.[/p][/*][*][p]Don't play hit stop if enemies are invulnerable.[/p][/*][*][p]Lots of bugfixes.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Demo Update 0.2.0
notes.content: [p]The demo has been updated to version 0.2.0.[/p][list][*][p]Improved player responsiveness when moving and increased speed of attacks.[/p][/*][*][p]Increase speed of camera tracking to be more responsive.[/p][/*][*][p]Add an attack that cancels the forward roll.[/p][/*][*][p]These changes make the player much more responsive. If you found combat laggy in previous versions try it again it feels much better.[/p][/*][*][p]Remember which enemies were killed in the previous room. Enemies now respawn when you get 2 rooms away.[/p][/*][*][p]Synchronize demo code with internal development version.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Demo Update 0.1.0
notes.content: [p]The demo build has been updated based on feedback and internal testing.[/p][list][*][p]There is now a control guide that shows what buttons perform what actions.[/p][/*][*][p]Initial shader compilation progress is now shown on screen. You can play during this time, but performance will be reduced during compilation.[/p][/*][*][p]The camera behaves better near walls and will move upward so you can still see.[/p][/*][*][p]The character will hold their shield more to the side and have more motion when you go to block.[/p][/*][*][p]Enemies move a little slower than the original demo version.[/p][/*][/list]
